content: Na'en bo'iave ji'cho
Omboe tsu Na'su Chigaja Noéma su: “Tsa'o shavonga ca'ni'faja que aindeccui'ccu. Nane que'iyi qui va ja'ño cansuite'su aindeccu'suma ño'amba ñama paña'fa.
Poi anqque'su vaura, oveja'can'ma'qque siete quitsa'ye, siete pusheveyi poiyi'cco'suma ca'niajan. Tsa'ma an'masia'ma aqquia fae quitsa'ye, fae pusheveyi poiyi'cco'suma ca'niaña'cho.
Toya'caen osha'cho chhiririama'qque poiyi'cco'suma siete quitsa'ye, siete pusheveyi tsu ca'niaña'cho. Nane pa'cco jincho'choma tsu ca'niaña'cho fae jincho'cho qquesa'ne.

Ñoa'me gi su siete a'tave pasasi tsu unjin tuiye ashaeña. Nane cuarenta a'ta, cuarenta cose'qque tsu unjinjan tuiya. Pa'cco va ande'su cansian jincho'choma tsu ccuchapa fi'ttiya, pa'cco ña agattoen'choma.”
Na'su Chiga mandaqquia'caen tsu Noéjan tson.
Na'en tsa'caen andenga bo'iave ji'jeni Noéjan seisciento canqque'fave an'biamba
shavonga ca'ni. Tise pushe, tise dutssiyendeccu, tise'pa pushendeccu'qque tsu poiyi'cco Noéi'ccu fae'ngae ca'ni'fa na'eñe ccushaye.
Cansian jincho'cho, majan anqque'su, majan an'masia, majan chhajeqque'su, majan manguqque'su
Noéi'ccu fae'ngae ca'ni'fa. Nane dos, dosveyi, quitsa'yeja tise pushei'ccu tsu Chiga mandaqquia'caen ca'ni'fa.
Siete a'ta pasasi na'enjan andema piccoye ashaen.

Nane Noéjan seisciento canqque'fave an'biansi segundo ccovu, a'ta diez y sieteni tsu pa'cco ande'su tsa'ccu sombo'je'ttija fettaye cuintsu ande tsosini'su tsa'ccu somboye. Toya'caen sefacconi'qque fettayeqquia'caen tsu sefacconi'su tsa'ccu amppi.
Nane cuarenta a'ta, cuarenta cose'qque tsu tsa'caen tui'je.
Tsa'caen unjin tuiyaqui a'ta tsu Noé, tise dutssiyendeccu, Sem, Cam, Jafet'qque ca'nisi Noé pushe, dutssiyendeccumbe pushendeccu'qque ca'ni'fa.
Tsendeccu toya'caen poiyi'cco cansian jincho'cho, poiyi'cco vaura'can, poiyi'cco andenga manguqque'su poiyi'cco chhiriria'qque tsu ca'ni'fa.
Noéi'ccu dos, dosveyi poiyi'cco cansian jincho'choja quitsa'ye tise pushei'ccu Chiga mandaqquia'caen ca'ni'fa.
Poiyi'cco ca'nisi Na'su Chigaja sombo'ttima picco.
Cuarenta a'ta tsu na'enjan bo'iave ji. Bo'iave jipa tsa'o shavoma sufottoen.
Ti'tsse, ti'tsse tsu tsa'ccuja ji. Tsa'ma tsa'o shavoja ombanga sufotto.
Nane tsa'ccu jipa pa'cco biani'su ande'su se'fatssia ccotta'ccoma'qque picco.
Pa'cco ccotta'ccoma piccopa toya tsu tsa'ccuja faesu siete metrove ji.
Tsa'caen jisi poiyi'cco andeni can'jen'cho aindeccuja pa'fa. Chhiriria, osha'cho vaura'can, tsampini canseqque'su, andenga manguqque'su'qque pa'fa.
Pa'cco va andeni cansian jincho'cho tsu pa'fa.
Nane Noéñi, tisei'ccu tsa'o shavonga ca'ni'chondeccuyi tsu ccushapa canse'fa. Poiyi'cco cca'indeccuja pa'fa —a'i, vaura'can, sefani'su chhiriria, andenga manguqque'su'qque pa'fa.
Na'enjan tsa'caen jipa ciento cincuenta a'ta sambambe'yi andema picco.
